title: SafeFlow: Real-Time Text-Driven Humanoid Whole-Body Control via Physics-Guided Rectified Flow and Selective Safety Gating
abstract: arXiv:2603.23983v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent advances in real-time interactive text-driven motion generation have enabled humanoids to perform diverse behaviors. However, kinematics-only generators often exhibit physical hallucinations, producing motion trajectories that are physically infeasible to track with a downstream motion tracking controller or unsafe for real-world deployment. These failures often arise from the lack of explicit physics-aware objectives for real-robot execution and become more severe under out-of-distribution (OOD) user inputs. Hence, we propose SafeFlow, a text-driven humanoid whole-body control framework that combines physics-guided motion generation with a 3-Stage Safety Gate driven by explicit risk indicators. SafeFlow adopts a two-level architecture. At the high level, we generate motion trajectories using Physics-Guided Rectified Flow Matching in a VAE latent space to improve real-robot executability, and further accelerate sampling

translated_title: SafeFlow：基于物理引导校正流与选择性安全门控的实时文本驱动人形机器人全身控制
translated_abstract: 实时交互式文本驱动运动生成的最新进展使人形机器人能够执行多样化的行为。然而，仅基于运动学的生成器常常出现“物理幻觉”，所产生的运动轨迹在物理上不可行，导致下游运动跟踪控制器难以跟踪，或对真实世界部署不安全。这些失败通常源于缺乏面向真实机器人执行的显式物理感知目标，并且在分布外（OOD）用户输入下问题会变得更加严重。因此，我们提出SafeFlow，一个将物理引导的运动生成与由显式风险指标驱动的三阶段安全门控相结合的文本驱动人形机器人全身控制框架。SafeFlow采用两级架构：在高层，我们在VAE潜空间中使用物理引导的校正流匹配生成运动轨迹，以提升真实机器人的可执行性，并进一步加速采样。
tldr: SafeFlow提出将物理引导校正流与三阶段安全门控相结合的文本驱动人形机器人全身控制框架，有效解决了纯运动学生成器的物理幻觉问题，提升了运动轨迹的真实机器人可执行性与部署安全性。
en_tdlr: SafeFlow proposes a text-driven humanoid whole-body control framework combining physics-guided rectified flow with a three-stage safety gate, addressing physical hallucinations in kinematics-only generators and improving real-robot executability and deployment safety.
